content.name: Freedom of Movement

components.m: a leather strap, bound around the arm or a similar appendage

entries: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause the target to be {@condition paralyzed} or {@condition restrained}.

The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature that has it {@condition grappled}. Finally, being underwater imposes no penalties on the target's movement or attacks.

content.name: Freedom of Movement
entries: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52}, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} nor cause the target to have the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} or {@condition Restrained|SRD52} conditions. The target also has a {@variantrule Swim Speed|SRD52} equal to its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}.
In addition, the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition on it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.
